sloka: हृता मृता वा नष्टा वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति ।निलीना अपि अथवा भीरुः अथवा वनम् आश्रिता ॥३-६०-८॥
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā naṣṭā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati ।nilīnā api athavā bhīruḥ athavā vanam āśritā ॥3-60-8॥

translations.english: 'Timid Sita might have been abducted or dead or crushed or eaten up by demons. Or, she may be hiding for protection in the forest'
